content.title: From Oishee to Apratim—The Silent Death of a Stolen Childhood!
content.subtitle: What abyss is your child slipping into?
content.body:
Close your eyes for a moment and picture a scene from just a few years ago. Your precious three-year-old child was throwing a tantrum, adamantly refusing to eat. Caught between exhausting household chores and endless office files, you felt completely overwhelmed. Desperate for a quick fix, you turned on a YouTube cartoon and placed the glowing phone into those soft, tiny hands. The magic worked instantly: the toddler went quiet, eyes locked onto the screen, swallowing each bite without a fuss. You exhaled a deep sigh of relief, convinced that a major daily battle had finally been won.

The Spread of a Silent Poison: From Cartoons to the Dopamine Trap

What you never realized was how that seemingly harmless cartoon quietly evolved from a one-hour distraction into an aggressive four-to-five-hour daily addiction. As the years passed, the growing child was handed a personal smartphone and private space. The bright, innocent animations soon failed to satisfy an overstimulated brain. The device's ruthless algorithms began steering the impressionable teenager toward competitive online games. Before long, flashy advertisements promising quick riches through online betting flooded the screen. Driven by curiosity, the naive adolescent wagered money and lost. In a frantic attempt to recover the financial loss, the teenager fell directly into the clutches of dark online networks designed to exploit and corrupt vulnerable youth.

The Apratim Murder: The Horror Looming Over Our Children

The horrific consequence of this virtual madness became brutally evident in the tragic murder of Ishayat Shahriar Apratim, an eighth-grader from Cumilla. Driven by the burning greed to possess an expensive iPhone, his own peers and classmates lured him away to murder him in cold blood. At an age when young hands should hold books and young feet should run across dusty fields, our children are being consumed by brand obsession, toxic virtual rivalries, and shocking criminality. This is not an isolated crime; Apratim’s lifeless body stands as a terrifying alarm bell for every family, exposing how unmonitored digital exhibitionism and gadget mania are turning tender young hearts to stone.

Pornography, Substance Abuse, and Moral Ruin

The descent into the abyss plunges even deeper. Chronic isolation combined with unfiltered high-speed internet pushes adolescents into the toxic world of pornography. Neuroscience shows that relentless dopamine spikes burn out the brain's natural capacity for empathy, focus, and genuine human connection. The fallout manifests at home: sudden violent outbursts, destruction of household items, outright rebellion against parents, and eventually, the fatal snare of drugs. It mirrors the haunting tragedy of Oishee, who once paralyzed the nation by murdering her own parents. The smartphone given so carelessly has turned into a lethal, silent weapon—one whose devastating toll we recognize only after catastrophe strikes.

Rescuing Our Children from the Brink of Destruction

To safeguard this sacred trust from Allah, we must take immediate, intentional steps:

  • Change yourself and lead by example: Children do not learn from verbal lectures; they replicate parental behavior. Scrolling through social media feeds while demanding that your child abandon screens is entirely futile. Cut down your own screen usage and revive the habit of reading physical books in front of them.

  • Offer undivided connection over screens: Despite exhausting work routines, set aside dedicated quality time each day. Look straight into your child’s eyes, listen attentively to their thoughts, and understand their unspoken anxieties. Rebuild an atmosphere of warm, candid conversations inside the home.

  • Reclaim the outdoors and nature: On weekends, break away from four confining walls and commercial shopping centers. Take your children to open playgrounds, parks, and lush greenery. Engaging in outdoor physical play is essential for healthy neurological development and mental resilience.

  • Cultivate a faith-centered home: Replace mindless digital entertainment with inspiring biographies of the Prophets and uplifting Islamic books. Establish a shared family habit of daily Quranic recitation and learning Sunnah supplications together.

Our children are a radiant, invaluable blessing from Paradise. Do not allow these precious souls to be reduced to ashes in the furnace of screen addiction for the sake of temporary domestic peace. Reach out today, gently take the device from their fingers, hold them close to your heart, and show them that true comfort and belonging exist in the unconditional warmth of family, not behind a cold, deceptive glass screen.
